column2: Chawfakna POS · chatuanin a man lovin
Chhun chaw hun buai. Internet a awm lo. Harsatna a awm lo.
Khaynjo hian i hmanrua neih sa hmangin i dawr chhung, buh chhumna leh zuar dawhkan te a kalpui — dawhkan aṭangin buh chhumnaah, buh chhumna aṭangin bil-ah, internet awm emaw awm lo emaw pawh ni se.
Android vawiin Google Play-ah · Windows leh Linux package a lo kal mek.
I lehkha te i hmanruaah a awm reng
Dawhkan pakhat hmet la, khual lo kal pakhat a tir aṭanga a tawp thleng en rawh. App-a rawng leh thumal ang chiah — tin, bil pek zawh hnuah chauh dawhkan a ruak ṭhin.

Ram tin chaw hmingthang pakhat — ram hming Sap ṭawngin, an ṭawng ziak dan ngeiin hming, leh chaw hming Sap ṭawngin. Chung thumal te chu i chaw list-ah ziak rawh. Khawvel hi a kal zel; en i duh chuan ti ding rawh, emaw zawng rawh.
Ram emaw chaw zawng rawh — entirnan India, biryani, Japan
Ram tin chaw hmingthang pakhat — he chaw tlar kal zel hian khawvel pum a fang chhuak.
Dawhkan pakhat, a tir aṭanga a tawp thleng.
Dawhkan chu ṭhut aṭanga pawisa pek thlengin engtin nge a kal en rawh — i hnathawktute’n app-ah an hmuh kalphung leh rawng ang chiah.
Dawhkanah ṭhuttir la, order la rawh
Khualte an ṭhut veleh dawhkan chu “Luah” tiin dah rawh. Chaw belh la, a lianzia thlang la, belhchhah belh la, buh chhumna tan note ziak rawh — dawhkanah ngei.
Lianzia pakhat thlang rawh; i ruat tawh zat thlengin i duh chuan belhchhah belh rawh.
“Thak tlem” chu a chaw nen chuan a kal ṭhin.
Buh chhumna hmun tin atan ticket pakhat

Order thawn la, buh chhumna hmun tinin an chaw chauh an dawng — ni tin number nen, dawhkan, rawih tu leh note tin nen. Man erawh chu engtikah mah a tel lo: buh chhumnain a chhum a, zuar dawhkanin bil a siam.
Thawn rawh, ticket chu a hmun dikah a inprint — tumahin an keng ngai lo.
Tunah eng nge chhum tur tih buh chhumnain a hmu

Buh chhumna screen-ah ticket te chu vawi khat hmet chauhin Thar → Buatsai mek → A peih-ah an kal. Ticket hlui te rawng a duk deuh deuh a, “Tunah chhum tur” chuan chaw nghak zawng zawng a chhiar a, chaw hmasa a kal thlengin chaw lian te an nghak thei.
Khualin a pek dan angin inchhiar fel rawh
Pawisa kirleh nen sum, QR-ah pawisa zat awm sa nen UPI, ṭhenkhat pek, emaw khual khata-ah ba. Thil, ṭhutna emaw inang tlangin ṭhen rawh. Bil pek zawh hnuah chauh dawhkan a ruak ṭhin.
Lawmman chu a hranin ziak a ni — zuarah engtikah mah a inpawlh lo.

Pawisa bawm chu ṭan sum, sum lak, lawmman leh sum pek nen chhiar rawh — a tlachham emaw a tam lutuk emaw chiang takin a lang. Shift lehkha print la, chumi hnuah hnathawktu, order chi, darkar leh chaw a zirin ni report hawng rawh — tihbo, a man lova pek chaw leh lawmman nen.
DAWR CHHUNG MAMAWH DANG ZAWNG ZAWNG
Chaw rawih tak tak atan siam.
Chhun chaw hun tin thleng ṭhin danglamna te — chiang takin enkawl a ni a, tu nge, engtikah nge leh engvanga nge ziak vek a ni.
Khualte’n dawhkan an thlak — order leh a minute te an hnenah a kal. Dawhkan pahnih, bil pakhat.
A chhan nen, chhum tawh emaw chhum loh emaw, leh tuin nge a phalsak. Buh chhumnain tihbo lehkha a dawng.
A man lova pek chaw chu bil-ah ₹ 0-in a awm a, a chhan leh phalsaktu nen.

Steady ₹6,000 · Swift ₹14,000 · Priority ₹28,000 / kum, chhiah tel lovin (chhiah chu pawisa pekna-ah). Duh ang chu man chhut a ni — Steady aiin a hniam emaw Priority aiin a sang thei. Engpawh ni se, local Khaynjo chu chatuanin a man lovin a awm reng.

I hmanrua ngeiah, i dawrah — kan server-ah a ni lo. Remkhawh aṭangin backup copy siam la, i duh hmunah dah rawh.

Ka hnathawktute’n an ṭawng ngei an hmang thei em?
Thei e. Screen te ṭawng 115-in a lo chhuak a, Arabic leh Urdu chu ding lam aṭanga vei lamah, chaw hming nen ziak dan dang hming dang pawh a dah theih.
I hmanrua ngeiah chuan pawisa engmah a ngai lo — a ṭhatna zawng zawng, chatuanin. I duh chuan Kumkaj Cloud chu kum tin Steady / Swift / Priority (emaw duh ang man chhut); lei turin /shop hawng rawh.
